# AK Render

> Declarative page compiler for coding agents: a short YAML or JSON Page Spec in, one deterministic, offline, self-contained HTML file out. The agent describes meaning; the compiler owns layout, colour, typography, motion, accessibility and security. npm package: `@bestagentkits/render`, CLI: `ak-render`.

Agent loop: find blocks with `ak-render search-catalog <intent words>` or `ak-render catalog [--category <c>]` (90 block types in 8 categories), optionally start from `ak-render recipe <name>` (list them with `ak-render recipes`), read contracts with `ak-render describe <type...> --compact` (full contract: `describe <type> --json`), `ak-render validate <spec|-> --json` and fix every diagnostic by its JSON path (`ak-render repair <spec> --out <spec>` applies the provably safe fixes; `validate --suggest` lists every fix as an RFC 6902 patch marked `safe` or `ambiguous`), then `ak-render <spec|-> --out page.html`. Edit later with `ak-render patch page.yaml '<RFC 6902 ops>' --json`: paths like `/blocks/@<id>/title` address a block by its `id` at any depth, the file keeps its YAML comments, and `--base-hash <hash>` from the previous reply refuses a stale edit. Pass `-` to read the spec from stdin. `ak-render mcp` exposes the same loop as MCP tools over stdio (`catalog`, `search-catalog`, `describe`, `search-icons`, `describe-icon`, `icon-packs`, `motions`, `recipes`, `recipe`, `validate`, `repair`, `patch`, `audit-motion`, `audit-ui`, `compose`, `render`, `themes`); `render` writes the file and returns only a summary. Shortcut for known page kinds: `ak-render compose input.yaml --out page.html --spec-out page.yaml` expands a typed intent (`ak-render compose intents --json`, e.g. `investment-report`) into a Page Spec and compiles it in one step.

Remote MCP over Streamable HTTP: `https://render.agentkit.best/mcp` serves the same tools for agents without Node. `render` and `compose` there take no `out`; it stores the page and returns the summary plus `artifactUrl` (one hour, or a 30-day share link with `share: true`), never the HTML. `retainSpec: true` on `render` keeps the spec too; the remote-only `artifact-export` tool returns signed, expiring download URLs for `html`, `png`, `pdf` or the retained `spec` (URLs only, never the bytes). Discovery tools (`catalog`, `search-catalog`, `describe`, the icon tools, `motions`, `recipes`, `recipe`, `themes`) need no token; `validate`, `repair`, `patch`, `audit-motion`, `audit-ui` (quick preset only), `compose`, `render` and `artifact-export` need `Authorization: Bearer <AgentKit token>`. Local compilation stays canonical and needs no account.

Do not write HTML, CSS or inline scripts: the spec has no field for them. In prose text props, a pair of backticks renders as inline code; nothing else is parsed as markup. Output makes no network request unless the spec opts in under `policy.network`. Shared numbers go in top-level `datasets` and blocks bind them with `dataRef`; page state, `visibleWhen`, native controls and `filter-bar` are declarative data too.

## Docs

- [Compose](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/compose.md): build a page from a typed intent and content slots in one call
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/agent-guide.md): the loop, a minimal spec, MCP setup, and rules that save retries
- [README](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/README.md): install, library API, CLI and the three agent modes
- [Cloud renderer](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/apps/cloud/README.md): remote MCP endpoint, REST routes, scopes and limits
- [Data and state](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/data-and-state.md): datasets, transforms, value formats, state, visibleWhen, controls and filter-bar
- [Motion recipes](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/motion.md): named, compiler-owned motion a block opts into with `motion: <recipe>`; find one with `ak-render motions search <intent>`, check a page with `ak-render motion audit <spec|page.html> --json`, tune it by eye with `ak-render motion studio <spec>`
- [Visual audit](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/audit-ui.md): `ak-render audit-ui <spec|page.html> --json` checks the compiled page; `--preset publication` adds a real-browser pass at 375/768/1440 px, light/dark, print, no-JS and reduced motion with the network blocked, and every finding carries a rule, spec path, viewport, evidence and fix
- [Themes](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/themes.md): the twelve built-in presets, component recipes, custom presets and embedded fonts
- [Media and network policy](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/docs/media-policy.md): what loads offline and how to opt in

## Reference

- [Page Spec JSON Schema](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/blob/main/schema/page-spec.v1.json): machine-readable schema for editors and validators
- [Example specs](https://github.com/bestagentkits/ak-render/tree/main/fixtures/pages): plan, explain, recap, diff, dashboard, media, interactive and showcase pages, one page per widget family, layout, data and theme feature, and six composition pages
